headline: Cyprus economy growth at 3.5% – Reforms and social support in focus
summary: Cyprus's economy grew 3.5%, according to a meeting between President Christodoulides and the Federation of Employers and Industrialists. Reforms and social support were the focus of the discussion.
why: Economic growth rates signal the strength of a small euro-area economy that hosts many international business and shipping firms.
